story: At 5:17 on a damp Tuesday afternoon in Sumter Oaks, the afternoon shower has just eased to a drizzle at 81 degrees. Gary is hopefully signing his golf cart up for Saturday's parade at the Town Square table, with the lights and sound noted as pending Architectural Review. Over at Rosa's House, Rosa clears her dining table so she and Donna can spread out blank paper and pencils and sketch removable, Review-friendly decorations. Meanwhile, Hal reads the committee meeting times and Halloween notices on the Magnolia Loop bulletin board, looking quite pleased with the week ahead.
events: Gary (parade signup table): Sign up my golf cart for Saturday's parade, noting the lights and sound are pending Architectural Review
Donna (rosa dining table): Spread out the cart sketches and start drawing up the Halloween parade design, Review-friendly
Hal (street bulletin board): Read the postings for committee meeting times and Halloween decoration notices
Rosa (rosa dining table): Clear the table and lay out blank paper and pencils to start sketching the removable parade cart decorations with Donna

gary.thought_process: I've filed the Architectural Review application and left my wiring sketches and clamp list in the drop box, so the paperwork side is done and I shouldn't hassle the desk again. Nobody's around in the Square. The parade is Saturday, and the flyer says decorations are welcome all week, so while I wait on the committee I can sign up for the parade here. I'll note that my cart's mods are pending Review. L-01 means I can't put anything visible on the cart until sign-off, and I'd rather keep Rosa's and Hal's trust than rush it.

parameters.content: Sign up my golf cart for Saturday's parade, noting the lights and sound are pending Architectural Review

donna.thought_process: Rosa wants to get the cart sketches done at the dining table while the rain lasts, and Hal is on his way. I've already said let's spread the sketches out, so no more chatter. I should do something. I'll go to the dining table, lay out the sketches and keep the ideas Review-friendly (nothing visible modified from the street until approval comes through), then get back to recruiting Gary for the ladder once the parade plans are rolling.

parameters.content: Spread out the cart sketches and start drawing up the Halloween parade design, Review-friendly

hal.thought_process: I've counted Donna's flamingos three times now and my notebook says three visible from the street, which squares with L-02. She pulled six inside herself, so there's nothing to report on that count, and I'll admit I'm a little pleased she complied. Gary's cart mods are the remaining matter, but Rosa and Gary agreed to wait for the committee's sign-off, so there's no violation to log yet. Nobody's around on Magnolia Loop in this shower. The bulletin board is right here, and with the Halloween flyer up and decorations coming all week, I should check it for any new notices about the parade or committee meetings. That's useful work for a man with a notebook.

parameters.content: Read the postings for committee meeting times and Halloween decoration notices

rosa.thought_process: Donna just agreed to spread the sketches out at the dining table while Hal is still on his way. I've already said I'll submit to Architectural Review once the drawings are done, so asking her again would just repeat myself. The rain is keeping us in, which is a good window. The useful move is to get to the table and start drawing. Keeping everything removable fits L-01 and what Gary told me about the wiring.

parameters.content: Clear the table and lay out blank paper and pencils to start sketching the removable parade cart decorations with Donna

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
